ai.title: Remove assistant change appendix from main-prompt
ai.summary: Removes `<edits_made_by_assistant>` appendix and `createFileBlock` import in `backend/src/main-prompt.ts`. Prevents bugs triggered by the appended edit context. Response now returns only the trimmed `fullResponse`.

eli5.text: The assistant stopped tacking its own edit history onto the end of its answers. Before this, it would paste a summary of the files it had touched right into the response it sent back, which occasionally made the replies behave incorrectly; now it sends only the trimmed response and leaves that appendix out. If you watched the replies coming back from this backend, they would no longer include that trailing block of edit information. This is in place today across the internal area flagged as minor.
